author: pk15
purpose: the certified entries of S_TB' Phase 2 rows P2-2 (SH1), P2-3 (SH2 by the odd Ritz route) and P2-8 (C4 by the double eigen trick), for pk03's entry engine; see STB_P2_PREP_v1.md
sources: factor lists of kt_sh1_v1.py 9a97356e and kt_c4_v1.py 79d369dd (float runs VALID), and STB_P2_PREP_v1.md sect. 2-4; revision v1_1 on the T51 (SOUND; notes 2 and 3) and pk03's answers on xh, K = 2 and e2; see STB_P2_PREP_v1_1.md; v1_2: S_TB' narrowed (the decision of 2026-11-07, option (B); STB_PHASE2_PLAN_v1_1 a90f7b52), so D1/D2's six entries (Gth, Ith, Gxh,0,0, X2, UL2, UR2) and the graphs only they used (DH, DTH, NTH, NTH2, 4UL2, 4UR2) are removed; D per entry by pk03's rule (by analysis); see STB_P2_PREP_v1_2.md; v1_3: P2-14's single-window second moments for P2-11's fourth kind (STB_PHASE2_PLAN_v1_3 570b21b8, NOTE_P2_14_HOME_v1 21afed5d): SM3,i,j on NTB (D3) and SM4,i,j on DT (D4), 15 entries per N

conventions.format: as pk11/out/S8_ENTRY_LIST_v1_1.json (8b4066f5): vertex 3*col + row (row 0 T, 1 M, 2 B), columns 0-indexed; column types vac/int as there; pairs listed per graph
conventions.cp: [cp, a, col] as S8_ENTRY_LIST_v1_1 (a = 0 vacres p; a >= 1 cluster state a; a = 2 is the odd state e2)
conventions.xi: [xi, TM|MB, col] as S8_ENTRY_LIST_v1_1 (vertical bond of column col)
conventions.xh: [xh, T|M|B, gap, w] = riglap3 xi factor on the horizontal bond (u, v) = (3*gap + r, 3*(gap+1) + r), r = 0, 1, 2 for T, M, B, built as the triple (u, v, w) with c9 = e_TM (xi on (u, v) alone; M3 reads only (u, v) for xi, anh and xibar). w is fixed per factor: riglap4.group_factors and M3's copy group factors by the triple's whole vertex set, so w sets the std grouping and the bars' Hoelder split, and C-REP-B needs the same grouping on both sides (pk03). Graphs that kt_sh1_v1 or kt_c4_v1 have keep their triples: T gap 0 XI(0,3,1), M gap 0 XI(1,4,2), T gap 1 XI(3,6,7), M gap 1 XI(4,7,8), B gap 1 XI(5,8,7). The two 4-column entries (UL3, UR3) take w = u (no extra vertex), which keeps their two xh groups apart. The bond is in the graph's pairs; C-XIT passed in kt_sh1_v1 and kt_c4_v1.
conventions.K: 3 unless marked K 2. The two 4-column entries UL3 and UR3 (F 20) take K = 2: a_0..a_2 exact at D = 6, and the order-2 remainder by bound5s with its overflow threshold lowered from i + j >= 4 to i + j >= 3, |a_3 t^3| <= t^3 sum_{i+j=3} ||F_i||_2 ||E_j||_2 (pk03; the one-line change goes to the review with the code). Its size is about 1e-7 to 1e-6 of the main-normalized entry, at most 5.1e-4 c2 for the UL3 + UR3 pair (D3, N = 3); C-C3 is unaffected, since c2..c4 use a_0..a_2 only.
conventions.trial_set: z9sym_v1, the one set of every certified run: pk11/out/ts_N4_J170_D_S_z9sym_v1.json (ea9d6c1b) and ts_N3_S_z9sym_v1.json (a298db65), record zero_states_v2_1 168106e0. Its column 2 (e2) is exactly c (e_TM - e_MB) (pk03), so C-ZFLIP (IhZb = -IhZ) and C-ZPAR (IhZh = 0) test exact zeros; M3 can certify IhZh = 0 by C-ODD and take IhZb as a signed mirror alias.
conventions.reused: from the S7/S8 lists, same trial set: g,0,0, g,2,2 (D), T,2,2 (clT), A,2 (b5) and KT-S9B's G, T, Ih, Dx and Gx,0,0 (S9 entries)
conventions.packing: ADD3 sect. 6 (pk03/PLAN_M3_CODE_v1_2_ADD3.md c0f202ed): MomTable needs (D + 1)^F < 9e18 and SPoly (largest series exponent + 1)^nv < 9e18, nv the series' variable space (M3 builds every series on all forms of the family graph). Each graph lists F (vertex plus pair forms), D_max and exp_max. Each entry lists D = deg F_0 + 2K by pk03's rule (cp a >= 1 contributes 2, cp 0 contributes 0, xi and xh 1), by analysis; M3's dry build at P2's prep replaces it with exact figures. Series exponents (pk03): an entry's own F_i reach about 8 per form at most; the graph-level stage-u products (h2^3) reach about 9, which fits nv <= 17 (every 2- and 3-column graph) but not nv 20, so the two 4-column entries wait for R2's smaller variable spaces (vertex-only H and majorants, per-group series; nv 12 allows exponents up to 36). pk03 traced the w triples: they change no grouping on the 2- and 3-column entries, and on the 4-column entries w = u keeps three groups (cp L | xh | xh + cp R).
conventions.p2_14: P2-14 (joint inputs of P2-11's fourth kind): the window moments M_ij = <phi_0, K xi_e^i xi_f^j phi_0>/main, i, j <= 2, on one graph per class, with vacuum states on both outer columns. Ratios M_ij/M_00 give the bulk moments of the window (the single trick's normalization cancels; its residual enters the certified bound), so E_bulk[X_c^2] = sum_ij C(2,i) C(2,j) (-m_e)^(2-i) (-m_f)^(2-j) M_ij/M_00 with X_c = (xi_e - c_e)(xi_f - c_f), m_e = M_10/M_00, m_f = M_01/M_00, and p_X^2 <= E_bulk[X_c^2] - Cov^2 (pointwise Cauchy-Schwarz). D3 = (t_i, bb_{i+1}) on NTB: SM3,i,j, with SM3,1,1 = X3. D4 = (t_i, b_i) on DT: SM4,i,j, with SM4,1,0 = Gxt,0,0 and SM4,1,1 = Y4. D4m = (t_i, b_{i+1}) is D4's mirror image, so its moments are D4's (a signed mirror alias, as IhZb; the float check C-SYM in kt_p2_14f_v1 confirms it). M_00 is computed on each class's own graph, so that the ratios stay on one graph.
